project_metadata.project_title: Wool and Fang: The Snare in the Timberline
project_metadata.style_preset: Cinematic dark fantasy realism, intricate fur and wool textures, atmospheric morning mist, rich organic film grain
project_metadata.spatial_geography_anchor: Meadowbrook Valley to Whispering Pines. North: steep forested pine ridges with ancient oaks and hunter's tension snare. South/Center: tranquil cobblestone village square, stone cottages, apple orchards, fortified iron-banded garrison gates.

action_library.title: Predatory Ridge Crouch & Scrutiny
action_library.promptText: Character crouches low in thorny brush, coiled shoulder blades, unblinking amber eyes tracking the valley below, claws digging into damp soil.

action_library.title: Explosive Bound & Perimeter Charge
action_library.promptText: Character sprints forward with low center of gravity, vaulting stone obstacles in lunging bounds, claws kicking up gravel and spray.

action_library.title: Heavy Bipedal Shoulder Check & Gauntlet Strike
action_library.promptText: Massive armored hound drives forward like a battering ram, slamming iron gauntlets and crushing wooden barricades with ground-shaking momentum.

action_library.title: Sudden Ankle Snare Recoil & Slam
action_library.promptText: Concealed noose snaps around ankle; character is yanked skyward in mid-air inversion before crashing violently against massive tree roots.

action_library.title: Cornered Tripod Defensive Stance
action_library.promptText: Wounded predator levers onto one knee and claw, baring bloody fangs, ears pinned flat, chest heaving with defiant ferocity.

action_library.title: Kneeling Sickle Sawing Mercy
action_library.promptText: Healer drops gently into damp moss beside the wounded creature, holding taut hemp rope with trembling hands and sawing furiously with curved iron sickle.

action_library.title: Silent Bounding Woodland Escape
action_library.promptText: Character executes a fluid, silent leap over bracken ferns, disappearing into swirling misty evergreen trees without a sound.

lighting_library.title: Overcast Dawn Fog & Cold Silver Rim
lighting_library.promptText: Cool 5600K diffused morning sky through dense pine canopy, heavy volumetric mist, pale silver rim light picking out wet fur and needle tips.

lighting_library.title: Diffused Morning Sunlight & High-Contrast Motion
lighting_library.promptText: 5000K morning daylight cutting through dissipating fog, dynamic hard motion shadows on wet cobblestones, high-contrast action lighting.

lighting_library.title: Dim Evergreen Canopy & God Rays
lighting_library.promptText: Low-key 4500K deep forest canopy ambient, soft white sun shafts slicing through misty pines, cool emerald bounce off mossy floor.

lighting_library.title: Warm Golden Sunshaft vs Cool Forest Fill
lighting_library.promptText: 4200K warm directional sunbeam illuminating cream fleece, contrasting with 6500K cool forest fill on silver wolf fur, ethereal chiaroscuro.
